business.description: During the year, the Company did not carry out its regular business activity. The company is actively searching for better avenues and opportunities.

outlook.statement: The company is actively searching for better avenues and opportunities, which will help the company in the long run.

India is the fourth largest global producer of agrochemicals. Global agrochemical market valued at USD 231.0 billion in 2020, projected to reach USD 315.3 billion by 2030. Indian agrochemicals market driven by growth in insecticides, increasing awareness, contract manufacturing and export opportunities.

Indian agriculture faces challenges: high dependence on monsoon, unpredictable weather, reduction in arable land, decreasing farm sizes, low per hectare yield, increase in pest attacks, agricultural workforce expected to reduce by 50% in coming decade. COVID-19 pandemic has put future plans in jeopardy and will take long time for economy to recover.
